purpose: Audit city-scoped land/cadastre evidence separately from accessible public parcel geometry; record only executed searches and actual page/request outcomes.
name: Bissau
pointBasis: Chosen approximate central-city query point; not a WUP centroid or official boundary.
jurisdiction: Municipal cadastral and land-service responsibilities are described by the Câmara Municipal de Bissau; national geospatial/cadastral functions also exist under the state geography and cadastre service.
registryBasis: The municipal site describes a Cadastro e Topografia service, records of municipal land, and processes for concession/legalization. The Portuguese-language municipal services portal lists municipal cadastre, land files, and regularization. These demonstrate city registry functions, not accessible parcel polygons.
findings: Direct inspection of the Bissau municipality website confirms its municipal cadastro/topography service processes land legalization/concessions, location plans, technical inspection, cadastral records, and final registration. The municipal services portal also categorizes municipal cadastre/land services. These are administrative, identity/payment-based workflows; neither page exposed anonymous parcel geometry or a public feature endpoint.
